beats.event: Idealistic Dorothea Brooke plans to marry Casaubon
Dorothea marries elderly clergyman Edward Casaubon
Dr. Lydgate arrives seeking to reform medical practice
Fred Vincy expects to inherit from uncle Featherstone
In Rome, Dorothea discovers the marriage's emptiness
Befriends Will Ladislaw, arousing Casaubon's jealousy
Lydgate takes Bulstrode's funding; courts Rosamond
Featherstone dies leaving Fred nothing
Lydgate marries the vain, extravagant Rosamond
Casaubon dies
Casaubon's will disinherits Dorothea if she marries Ladislaw
Mary Garth refuses Fred until he matures
Lydgate's marriage strains under Rosamond's extravagance
Raffles arrives, exposing Bulstrode's sordid past
Bulstrode hastens Raffles's death
Bulstrode's disgrace damages Lydgate's reputation
Lydgate must leave town, reform ambitions destroyed
Fred trains as land agent and wins Mary through reform
Dorothea marries Ladislaw despite family disapproval
Finale: characters' later lives — compromise, limited idealism
